snippets.ELOISE_POSTCARD:
Hello dear Panda.
So far you haven't been able to choose the opponent for your racing Pokopet. This will change now! From now on you can decide with which Pokopet you'd like to enter a race! Just click on the Pokopet you'd like to race against. Below you can see how it goes. If the owner of the Pokopet accepts your request, the race may start! So, break a leg... I mean - Good luck! See you soon!
Love, Eloise

snippets.MODERATION_RULES_ACCEPT_INTRO_PANFU: To make Panfu a nice and friendly place we have a few easy chat rules:
snippets.MODERATION_RULES_NEW_LANGUAGE: Don't be a bully and don't use bad or rude language.
snippets.MODERATION_RULES_NEW_MEET: Never meet up with another player without being accompanied by your parents.
snippets.MODERATION_RULES_NEW_PASSWORD: Never reveal your password to anyone.
snippets.MODERATION_RULES_NEW_REPORT: If chatting with someone makes you feel uncomfortable, stop chatting with them and report the player to a moderator!
snippets.MODERATION_RULES_NEW_WEBSITES: Please don't mention other websites, as we can't guarantee your safety there.
snippets.MODERATION_RULES_PANFU_GAME_SCREEN_INTRO: Dear Pandas! We love the chat function as much as you do. So we ask you to join hands with our moderators and do your share to help keep the Panfu chats very safe and free from bullying and bad language.
snippets.MODERATION_RULES_PANFU_NEW_SHARE: Don't share personal information such as your email address, phone number, the name of your school or your instant messenger ID.
snippets.MODERATION_RULES_PANFU_NEW_TREAT: Be friendly and treat others as you would like to be treated yourself.
snippets.MODERATION_SAFE_FILTER_AUTO: Advanced automatic filters that prevent the display of bad language and personal information.
snippets.MODERATION_SAFE_FILTER_EMAIL: All players have to register and confirm their registration through a real email address.
snippets.MODERATION_SAFE_FILTER_HOURS: Outside chat hours, players can only send predefined chat messages.
snippets.MODERATION_SAFE_FILTER_IGNORE: By ignoring another player, all of his or her chat functions and messages will be hidden from you.
